messages:
alex: Hey team — customer AcmePayments seeing intermittent structured-output validation errors for function calling. Error: validation_error: missing required field 'items[0].price'. Started ~2026-03-12 09:14 UTC. Example request id: rq_0a9c1f23456789. CC @maria @sophia

maria: Can you paste a raw curl and the function schema they use? Need model, route, and any special params (temperature, top_p, structured_output options).

alex: Repro curl they used:
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: rq_0a9c1f23456789" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-serve-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Create invoice items"}],"functions":[{"name":"create_invoice","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"description":{"type":"string"},"price":{"type":"number"}},"required":["description","price"]}},"required":["items"]}}],"function_call":{"name":"create_invoice"}}'
```

ben: Can you attach the customer log lines around rq_0a9c1f23456789? I want model routing/kernel selection + runtime validator output. Also confirm whether this happens with other model variants.

sophia: Does this only happen when function_call is used? Or does plain text -> post-processing to JSON also fail?

alex: Only when function_call/schema present. Plain generations are fine. Function schema (simplified):
```json
{"name":"create_invoice","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"description":{"type":"string"},"price":{"type":"number"}},"required":["description","price"]}},"required":["items"]}}
```

luis: Guessing we hit a case where model emits a string for price ("free") or omits price for discount item. Try repro with deterministic settings + strict schema validation flag.

luis: Suggested curl to force stricter behavior:
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: rq_debug_0001" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-serve-1-q8","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Create invoice items"}],"functions":[{"name":"create_invoice","parameters":{...}}],"function_call":{"name":"create_invoice"},"temperature":0,"structured_output":{"strict":true}}'
```

support-bot: Upload URL (expires in 24h) for debug bundle: https://internal.s3.redwood/support-upload/rq_0a9c1f23456789
Instructions: include full client request, response, and any local SDK logs. Mark filename debug_bundle_rq_0a9c1f23456789.tar.gz

acme-support: Uploaded debug_bundle_rq_0a9c1f23456789.tar.gz to the URL. Also found additional request ids: rq_0a9c1f23456790,rq_0a9c1f23456791 — failures seem clustered 09:14-09:19 UTC.

ben: Got the bundle. Grepping our logs:
```
2026-03-12T09:14:07Z INFO request= rq_0a9c1f23456789 model=gptx-serve-1 kernel=v2.8
2026-03-12T09:14:08Z ERROR request= rq_0a9c1f23456789 validator=schema_validator validation_error=\"items[0].price: missing required property\"
2026-03-12T09:14:08Z DEBUG request= rq_0a9c1f23456789 output_raw=\"{\\\"items\\\":[{\\\"description\\\":\\\"discount\\\"}]}\"
```

ben: Looks like the model output omitted price in token stream. Next steps: run repro with q8 quantized variant and structured_output.strict=true, then capture request id and full raw output. I'll instrument an extra validator log to print token boundaries for that request.

maria: Escalating to P1. @ben @luis please coordinate a 30min debug session with Acme (they're available 15:30 UTC). I'll follow up with calendar invite and summary.

alex: Thanks, team. I'll keep the customer in-thread and post updates. :thumbsup:
